name: Escort's Secrets 18+
source:
[b]Escort's Secrets 18+[/b] is a captivating visual novel that follows the story of Hensel, a complete underachiever and a cheerful adventurer, who possesses an extraordinary talent for charming and doing the opposite. 

Hensel has always had an incredible inability to refrain from adventuring and an uncanny knack for getting into extreme trouble. Poor humor, bad jokes, and the ability to find himself in the most ridiculous situations are just a few of the traits that make Hensel an unforgettable character.

However, one fateful day, Hensel is caught cheating in a casino, and his life is threatened by the mafia's enforcers. To save his own skin, he must accept a peculiar offer: to become a male escort for stunning ladies in search of suitable companions.

[b]Escort's Secrets 18+[/b] will allow you to immerse yourself in a world of intrigue, entertainment, and secrets, where even the least talented hero can find his place among affluent women, or he may simply find himself in a predicament with serious consequences. 

Get ready for an unforgettable adventure that will uncover [b]Escort's Secrets 18+[/b] and reveal the world of Hensel and his intricate relationships with the women who pay for his company, as well as the secrets he keeps from everyone.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2668160/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《[b]Escort's Secrets 18+[/b]》是一部引人入胜的视觉小说，讲述了一事无成却生性乐观的冒险家亨塞尔的故事——他不仅拥有迷倒众生的非凡魅力，还总能把事情搞得适得其反。

亨塞尔向来按捺不住四处闯荡的冲动，更是天生自带惹出滔天大祸的体质。蹩脚的幽默感、冷场烂梗，再加上总能一头栽进最荒唐处境的本事，无不让亨塞尔成为一个令人过目难忘的角色。

然而在命运转折的某一天，亨塞尔在赌场出老千被抓了个现行，黑手党打手随即向他发出死亡威胁。为了保住小命，他不得不接受一项离奇的条件：化身男伴游，专门陪伴那些寻觅合拍男伴的绝色名媛。

《[b]Escort's Secrets 18+[/b]》将带你沉浸于一个交织着暗流、欢场与秘密的世界——在这里，哪怕是最不成器的主人公也能在富婆名媛之间混得风生水起，又或者一不小心深陷泥潭、酿成严重后果。

准备好踏上一场难忘的冒险吧！在《[b]Escort's Secrets 18+[/b]》中揭开亨塞尔的世界，探寻他与那些花钱买他陪伴的女人们之间错综复杂的关系，以及他对所有人隐瞒的秘密。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2668160/]Steam[/url]]
